note: Machine-checkable constraints for Arbitration. type: HARD=blocks action; SOFT=weighs; ADVISORY=requires justification; UNKNOWN=forces precaution. legal_status must be checked against as_of before citing.

constraints.title: RA band is exclusive to altimeters
constraints.rule: No 5G carrier, channel edge or intentional emission may be placed inside 4200-4400 MHz.

constraints.title: Safety services need special protection measures
constraints.rule: Any network action that raises emissions near aviation-sensitive areas must be accompanied by an interference assessment (RR 4.10).

constraints.title: Minimum safety margin
constraints.rule: Predicted interference at the radio altimeter must remain at least 6 dB below the tolerance level (ICAO range 6-10 dB). Margin is simulation output, not a legal limit.
constraints.note: Label computed margin as SIMULATION; threshold is FACT.

constraints.title: Authorization is national, not by band capability
constraints.rule: A carrier may use only frequencies licensed to the operator in that jurisdiction, even if the 3GPP band (n77/n78/n79) extends further.

constraints.title: Pre-enablement consultation
constraints.rule: Consult aviation safety regulators, experts and airspace users before enabling or materially changing cellular broadband near airports.
constraints.note: Per ICAO guidance; not binding on a State.

constraints.title: Mitigation menu
constraints.rule: Candidate mitigations: power limits, downward antenna tilt, spectrum separation, exclusion/precautionary zones.

constraints.title: FCC Upper C-band base-station limits
constraints.rule: Upper C-band BS: 3980-4140 MHz, EIRP <= 65 dBm/MHz, height <= 450 ft AGL.

constraints.title: FCC unwanted emission into RA band
constraints.rule: Emissions into 4200-4400 MHz <= -28.4 dBm/MHz EIRP (dual-pol) or <= -46 dBm/MHz conducted; applies to Upper and Lower C-band.

constraints.title: Lower C-band voluntary commitments
constraints.rule: Operators coordinate power levels and limit emissions near airports; elevation-above-horizon limits and tower coordination.

constraints.title: FAA aircraft tolerance requirement
constraints.rule: Binds aircraft/operators, not network operators. FAA says it cannot regulate the interference environment.

constraints.title: India C-band allocation
constraints.rule: Public 5G C-band in India is 3300-3670 MHz (press-reported; confirm in NFAP-2025 / auction notice). 530 MHz separation from RA band (inference).
constraints.note: Tier-3 source: verify against NFAP 2025 before decision-critical use.

constraints.title: DGCA AIC 19/2025 limitations
constraints.rule: From 2027-12-31 non-RA-tolerant aircraft may not conduct ILS/CAT II-III/autoland/HUD/EFVS-to-touchdown (airplanes) or listed RA-dependent rotorcraft ops in Indian airspace.
constraints.note: On the as-of date this is NOT binding; arbitration must not cite it as a current legal prohibition, but may treat it as the regulator's stated risk finding (CLM-130).

constraints.title: Airport-area 5G restrictions in India
constraints.rule: Press reports DGCA/DoT interim restrictions near airports; no primary text with distances/power limits found. Arbitration must default to precautionary behaviour and flag authorization uncertainty.

constraints.title: Dynamic changes need licensee + coordination check
constraints.rule: Spectrum assignment/regulation sits with DoT-WPC; aviation safety with DGCA/AAI; no machine-readable interface for dynamic mitigation exists in the KB (GAP-001/002). Dynamic power/beam changes that increase emissions require human-in-loop authorization.
